value.rationale: Cohort mortality turning ages are naturally relevant to demographic aging and frailty selection. The new result identifies exactly when selection overwhelms shared Gompertz aging temporarily, distinguishes no-turning, two-turning, and one-turning regimes, provides a sharp physically interpretable parameter window and square-root onset, and separates a finite two-atom mechanism from known continuous gamma-frailty behavior.
